lines.text: Best pizza in town. Believe me?
This pizza is the best in town, no cap.

data.define: Used to say that you are being completely honest.

example.text: This pizza is the best in town, no cap.

misuse.text: Don't say 'no cap' about a baseball hat.

data.l1: gak bohong; serius deh; tanpa bohong
data.l1_hook: Pizza terbaik di kota. Percaya deh, "no cap".
data.l1_ex: Pizza ini yang terbaik di kota, no cap.

native.tip: “no cap” = gak bohong; serius deh; tanpa bohong. Contoh: “This pizza is the best in town, no cap.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “no cap”?
“no cap” = gak bohong; serius deh; tanpa bohong.
Contoh: “This pizza is the best in town, no cap.” (Pizza ini yang terbaik di kota, no cap.)
